Name: Harvey to Takuto Maruki(persona 5)
Author: thetrashysasser
Description: A portrait replacer mod for portraiture made to replace Harvey with Maruki from Persona 5, as was requested. Sadly there are no sprites that would fit very well with Harvey's  beach or headphone portraits so apologies if that irks anyone. to use the mod simply put the unzipped folder into the portraits folder in portraiture and find it with whatever button you have the hotkey set to
